feeds.what: every contested contest of the election in one static HTML page (statewide totals plus a per-county table for each contest)

headers_needed.User-Agent: a desktop browser User-Agent; the relay User-Agent gets a Cloudflare challenge (403)

feeds.saved_as: ent.chrome.html (the 200 answer to a Chrome User-Agent) and ent.relay-403.html (the challenge page the relay User-Agent got)
feeds.notes:
A generated static page (IIS/ASP.NET behind Cloudflare), 861,343 bytes uncompressed (71,163 gzip), Cache-Control: no-cache, with a real Last-Modified header. 107 contests, each a block:

title

,

Precincts Reporting: 4168 of 4168

, then rows of

D-Adam Hamilton

561,143

51%

, then 'Total Votes'. Each block has an anchor id='all-races-' (1001 = United States Senate). No JSON, XML or CSV was found anywhere on the site.

feeds.what: the same blocks split by group: federal contests only
feeds.notes: Sibling pages, same markup: statewide.html, ks-senate.html, ks-house.html, ks-boe.html, judicial.html, constitutional.html, Uncontested.html, and one page per county (allen.html … wyandotte.html). ks-senate.html, ks-house.html and constitutional.html are saved too. statewide.html answered 403 (challenge) even with the Chrome User-Agent on the one try.

election_id: None. The host serves one election at a time at fixed file names (kssos_ent.html, national.html, …). The challenge page's own metadata still says '2026 Primary Election Results', so the same URLs were used for the August primary.
discovery: Nothing to discover: the URL is the same every election and shows whichever election the office last loaded. The only check available is the banner image name (ks_images/header_general.jpg) and the date in 'Last Updated'.
bot_blocking: Relay User-Agent: 403 with 'Cf-Mitigated: challenge' (Cloudflare managed challenge). The 403 body is a 659 KB custom challenge page styled as the results page (title 'Unofficial Kansas Election Results', a meta refresh every 5 seconds), so it must be told apart by status code, not by content. curl with a desktop Chrome User-Agent: 200 on kssos_ent.html, national.html, ks-senate.html, ks-house.html and constitutional.html, but 403 challenge on statewide.html in the same minute, so a browser User-Agent is not a reliable pass either.
updated_field: In the page: 11/08/2026 9:14 PM after 'Last Updated:', no zone given; Kansas's capital is on US Central time, and the HTTP Last-Modified header of the same page was 'Mon, 09 Nov 2026 03:15:50 GMT' (= 9:15 PM CST), which confirms Central. Each county also has 'Last Reported: 11/06/2026 03:54 PM'.
reporting_field: Per contest, text: 'Precincts Reporting: 4168 of 4168'. Per county, text: 'Allen County 22 of 22 precincts'.
choice_format: Party letter, hyphen, name, in one text node: 'D-Adam Hamilton', 'R-Roger Marshall', 'L-David C Graham'. Votes have thousands separators ('561,143'); percentages are whole numbers ('51%'). The measure's statewide rows read 'Constitutional Amendment - "YES"' and 'Constitutional Amendment - "NO"'; its county tables say 'Yes' / 'No'.
district_field: Only in the title, as a bare trailing number with no word 'District' ('United States House of Representatives 1', 'Kansas House of Representatives 123', 'Member, State Board of Education 3', 'Supreme Court Justice 4').
